Redwood changes in Oracle Fusion 26D for ERP, Procurement and Supply Chain

Outside HCM, Oracle's 26D What's New documents name Redwood in 26 feature titles: 2 in Financials, 5 in Procurement, 15 in Supply Chain & Manufacturing and 4 in Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS). Per Oracle's Action to Enable column: 8 on by default, 1 on by default with potential setup, 12 setup required, 3 opt-in, 2 needing another action.

We list every row whose Oracle title contains "Redwood". Oracle delivers other Redwood work under titles that don't use the word, so check your module pages too. For HCM, see HCM pages switching to Redwood.

Every row comes from the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's 26D What's New documents, with Oracle's own "Impact to Existing Processes" and "Action to Enable" columns as Oracle states them. Each title links to Oracle's feature page. Oracle can revise its documents; we recheck them every week. Always confirm on the linked Oracle page.
